title: The chance of at least one success
question: Something works with the same chance every time you try. How likely is it to work at least once in a number of tries?

result.name: Q
result.label: Chance of at least one success (0 to 1)

chart.title: The chance of at least one success, try by try

notes: Every try has the same chance.
One try does not change the chance of the next.
source: the complement rule of probability: the chance of at least one success is one minus the chance that every try fails.

practice.prompt: Each try works 20% of the time. What is the chance of at least one success in 5 tries?
With a 5% chance each try, how many tries make the chance of at least one success a coin flip: within 0.02 of 0.5?
